description: This file is a test script for Git fetch operations involving negative refspecs, including setup of repositories, testing fetch behaviors, push behaviors, and refspec manipulations. It defines multiple test cases with setup commands and assertions to validate Git's handling of negative refspecs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and reports the result.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that are expected to fail, asserts failure.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file, used for setup or expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for setup or testing purposes.
